The video commentary names 'Suarez' (with Diaz setting him up) — i.e. Colombian striker Luis Javier Suárez (Sporting CP), whose full name is in fact Luis Suárez.
why_note_decision: The player's actual name IS Luis Suárez (full: Luis Javier Suárez Charris) — he plays for Sporting CP and Colombia. The tweet is accurate; the OCR even shows 'COLOMBIA' on screen and the commentator says 'Suarez' setting up off Diaz. The note is pedantic in clarifying he's not the Uruguayan Luis Suárez of Inter Miami — useful if a reader were genuinely confused, but the on-screen team name and commentator made it clear, and most replies already correctly identified the player. 7 NNN on only 10 raters; small sample but consistent with note-not-needed framing. The Uruguayan Suárez plays for Inter Miami in MLS; he wouldn't be playing in an international friendly for Colombia. Context is sufficient.
